features.title: AI harness foundation
features.summary: Give human and AI contributors a durable product contract, feature checkpoint registry, verification path, and mandatory human review gate.

in: Non-interactive test and build verification command
Human approval before commit, push, or pull request

acceptance_criteria: AGENTS.md explains the product, repository map, feature lifecycle, verification path, change rules, and definition of done.
feature_list.json records feature status, scope, checkpoints, evidence, verification, and human review state.
The grill-me workflow turns an ambiguous feature request into an approved, testable feature brief before implementation.
npm run verify runs tests non-interactively and creates a production build.
Agents must present changes and verification results for explicit human approval before commit, push, or pull request.

checkpoints.summary: Document the product, source map, commands, behavior contract, change rules, and definition of done.
Provide one non-interactive command for tests and production build.
Create the machine-readable feature and checkpoint registry.
Create a reusable interview workflow for clarifying features before implementation.
Require explicit human review after changes and before any commit, push, or pull request.

risks: Feature records can drift from the repository unless every handoff updates checkpoint evidence.
The current verification suite is a smoke test and does not yet protect all user-visible behavior.

human_review.notes: The complete AI harness was reviewed and approved before commit.
